static_traits.name: Li Ming川
static_traits.social_status: 有两位朋友可交谈，但难以就自卑与not足坦诚表达；近期与亲友疏远
static_traits.medical_history: 既往轻度过敏，No major physical illness；without以往心理问题与治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高，表达清晰，思路连贯，能识do not并描述内心体验；语气平和，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我认为我的写作很差且have not天赋，这导致了without价值感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these thoughts began to affect my writing ability and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, after multiple publisher rejections, I received one negative writing feedback, triggering strong frustration and self-doubt; since then, in writing scenes, I repeatedly recall that feedback and the rejection experiences, and emotional pressure gradually intensified.
长期与父母关系疏远，Living alone，社会支持相对薄弱；虽有两位朋友可交流，但因Low sense of self-worth而not易向他人坦诚表达not足与脆弱，逐渐Social avoidance。

Works were once accepted by a small publication, and a senior book-loving friend once positively evaluated their short stories; however, these positive experiences are often overshadowed by negative feedback and are hard to internalize into stable evidence of self-ability.

special_situations.event: When sitting down to start writing, recalls past negative feedback and multiple rejections
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品被拒或被批评，就证明我have not天赋，是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 寻求他人认同、报名写作课程以证明自己；有时减少写作以避免再度被negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的写作很差，我根本have not天赋

special_situations.event: 将自己与成功Writer进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到他们的水平，就not配称为Writer，也have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断比较与自我苛责，回避展示与分享作品
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远比not过他们，我not如人

special_situations.event: 收到出版社拒稿或回想那次负面反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次或几次负面反馈就能证明我have not天赋，将来也not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复回放批评内容，忽视或淡化正向证据

special_situations.event: 从朋友或小型刊物获得正向反馈与认可
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有来自权威或大刊物的认可才算数，其他的not作数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过贬低来源或解释为“只是安慰”来negate积极反馈，以维持原有信念
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是安慰我/小刊物not算数

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被看见为有才华并得到肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与Being rejected，担心被评价为without能与have not价值
defense_goal: 通过回避暴露与降低写作产出来减少被negate的机会
通过寻求外部验证来暂时缓解Self-doubt
淡化正向反馈以维持可预测的自我图式从而降低not确定性带来的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: have not天赋、容易失败与被negate的人
object_relations.object_representation: Critical, harsh others prone to rejecting and belittling (such as editors / readers / authorities)
情感上疏远或not回应的他人/家庭

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive evidence or invites a more balanced perspective to reframe self-evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些正面证据“并not算数”，体验到“对方not理解现实的严苛”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气礼貌但坚持，用“not过/但是”等词淡化正向证据、Reinforcement负面解释。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing sharing works, seeking feedback, or setting concrete writing goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipation他人会negate或嘲笑自己，将潜在拒绝视为确定结局
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以回避或推迟的方式回应，强调“时机not yet到/准备not够”，减少实际暴露。

manifestations: 主动与亲友疏离，难以向朋友敞开心扉
在写作受挫时更倾向于自我隔离
outcomes: Reduced social support，寂寞与without助感增加

manifestations: Regarding writing success and 'talent' as the sole basis of self-worth
After rejections and criticism, experiences a hollow feeling of 'I am wasting my time'
outcomes: Self-doubt与低落加剧，难以内化正向经验

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 内化“只有权威认可才算数、have not天赋就not配写作”的标准
在被指出正向反馈时说“这些not算数/只是安慰”，negate积极证据

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我苛责、标签化自我（without才/without能）
Continually belittling oneself in comparisons, avoiding sharing work to prevent being evaluated

exception_events.target_problem: 在写作或面对反馈时，来访者通常会聚焦负评、negate正向证据，并产生“我have not天赋”的Self-doubt，从而减少写作产出。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 某次作品被小型刊物接受发表，获得客观正向评价，与以往的Self-denialnot同，这次带来一段时间的信心提升。
exception_events.reason: 线索：获得客观的正向外部反馈与录用结果，为能力提供了直接证据，短期减轻了Self-doubt。

exception_events.target_problem: 在与他人谈及写作时，来访者通常会Anticipation被negate而回避深入交流，维持孤立与自卑。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 一次由资深爱读者的朋友对其短篇故事给予具体称赞，当下能短暂接纳并感到鼓舞，与平时自动negatenot同。
exception_events.reason: 线索：来自可信赖读者的具体化正向反馈提供了not同视角，增强了可被认可的体验。

positive_force: Proactively seeks improvement: has attended writing courses and is willing to try behavioral experiments
Has a certain amount of successful experience (accepted by small publications, positive feedback from friends)
Motivation is still there, willing to set writing goals and collect evidence for evaluation
negative_force: 认知偏差显著（negate正向、过度概括、非黑即白、比较与despair）
过度依赖外部验证，难以内化积极经验
Social avoidance导致支持系统弱化，加剧without价值感
自尊低下与自我标签化，增加写作情境中的Anxiety与回避

target_behavior.behavior: 写作时反复出现“我写得很差、have not天赋”的自我贬低思维并减少写作
antecedent: 回想或收到负面反馈/拒稿
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizes 'talent = self-worth' as a rigid standard, and applies mental filtering and overgeneralization to negative feedback
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻感，短时降低Anxiety与not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: 写作产出下降，Career development受阻，自尊进一步降低

antecedent: 想到要谈论作品或寻求反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被negate与羞辱，将潜在拒绝视为确定结果
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support、Loneliness感增加，睡眠与食欲被影响
